response.text: The high consumer lag on Kafka partition 7 is caused by a poison message at offset 88123410 in the events-consumer service, which is retrying indefinitely. I restarted the events-consumer service to clear the stuck state, but the lag remains high. I have paged the on-call engineer for manual intervention to handle the poison message and posted a public status update for customers.
